title: Safe Pro Group Reports Record Q3 2026 Revenue of $2.68 Million, Up 2,539% Year-over-Year & 101% Sequentially, with Record 79% AI Gross Margin
summary: AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) ("Safe Pro" or the "Company"), a developer of artificial intelligence
body_markdown:
Net Loss Narrows 69% to $(0.08) Per Share; Q3 Revenue Exceeds Preliminary Estimate; First U.S. Army Prime Contract Awarded for AI Threat Detection Onboard Anduril Ghost-X Drone


AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) (“Safe Pro” or the “Company”), a developer of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled defense, security, and situational awareness solutions, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


Record quarterly revenue increased 2,539% year-over-year to $2,676,680, more than doubled sequentially from the second quarter of 2026, and exceeded the Company’s preliminary estimate of more than $2.5 million announced on October 7, 2026. During the quarter, the Company’s Safe Pro AI subsidiary achieved record gross margin of 79%, lifting Safe Pro’s consolidated gross margin to 71.2% from 33.1% a year ago. Net loss decreased 69% year-over-year to $1,544,870, or $(0.08) per share, compared with $5,010,358, or $(0.29) per share, in the third quarter of 2025. Non-GAAP adjusted net loss (as defined below in “Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures”) decreased to $401,689, or $(0.02) per share, compared with $1,524,538, or $(0.09) per share, in the third quarter of 2025, which the Company believes demonstrates progress toward operational break-even on a non-GAAP basis.


“Third quarter revenue more than doubled sequentially to a record level and our AI segment gross margin reached a record 79%, significantly reducing our net loss, evidence we believe demonstrates that our patented American AI is scaling with operating leverage,” said Dan Erdberg, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Safe Pro Group Inc. “After the quarter, we received our first U.S. Army prime contract, combining our AI with Anduril’s Ghost-X drone and Lattice, marking a milestone in our business as we continue to move from being a subcontractor to a prime contractor. We believe this latest award reflects a clear need across the defense sector for technology such as ours which can help address the evolving threats facing our armed forces.”


Mr. Erdberg concluded, “We believe the increasing activity across our pipeline with the U.S. Army, U.S. Air Force and U.S. Department of State positions Safe Pro for continued growth in the months ahead. I am proud of our dedicated team for bringing our technologies to our soldiers and advancing Safe Pro’s global mission of helping to protect lives.”


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights**


*All comparisons are to the third quarter of 2025 unless otherwise noted.*


- **Record revenue of $2,676,680** , up 2,539% from $101,422 and up approximately 101% sequentially from $1,332,074 in the second quarter of 2026. Revenues were primarily driven by U.S. Army and other U.S. government-contracted sales of the Company’s AI-powered edge compute, threat detection and mapping products and related services and support.
- **Safe Pro’s AI segment revenue was $2,106,929** , compared with $0, representing 79% of total consolidated company revenue in the third quarter reflecting the successful commercialization of its Safe Pro AI subsidiary.
- **Record AI segment gross margin of 79%,** up from 75% in the second quarter of 2026 and more than 72% in the first quarter of 2026, underscoring the scalability of the Company’s software and edge compute product lines.
- **Gross margin expanded to 71.2% from 33.1%,** with gross profit increasing to $1,904,534 from $33,594.
- **Operating expenses decreased 30.5% to $3,523,857** from $5,072,097, and loss from operations decreased 68% to $1,619,323 from $5,038,503.
- **Net loss decreased 69% to $1,544,870, or $(0.08) per share** , from $5,010,358, or $(0.29) per share, and decreased 51% sequentially from $3,168,862, or $(0.15) per share, in the second quarter of 2026.
- **Non-GAAP adjusted net loss of $401,689, or $(0.02) per share,** compared with $1,524,538, or $(0.09) per share, in the third quarter of 2025. A reconciliation of GAAP net loss to non-GAAP adjusted net loss is provided in the tables below.
- **Accounts receivable of $2,938,338** at September 30, 2026, up from $100,028 at December 31, 2025, and **contract liabilities (contracted revenue to be recognized in future periods) of $515,893** , up from $18,897, reflecting rapid execution against awarded government contracts.
- **Cash of $7,781,051, working capital of $9,716,967 and minimal debt** .


**Recent Contract and Operational Highlights**


- **First U.S. Army prime contract.** Subsequent to the close of the third quarter, on November 10, 2026, Safe Pro announced it was[awarded a $2.5 million U.S. Army prime contract](https://safeprogroup.com/safe-pro-group-awarded-u-s-army-prime-contract-teams-with-anduril-for-super-intelligence-on-ghost-x-drone-for-tank-protection/) for its AI technology running onboard the Anduril Ghost-X drone focused on protecting the Army’s Abrams Tanks. The Ghost-X drone was selected by the U.S. Army under its Medium Range Reconnaissance (MRR) program.
- **Third quarter deliveries.** Third quarter revenue included deliveries under a $1.3 million subcontract from a U.S. defense prime contractor to integrate real-time AI threat detection onto autonomous unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs), and under a $780,000 U.S. Army award for a package including the Company’s NODE AI edge-processing systems and Blue UAS drones.
- **New U.S. Department of State relationship.** In August 2026, the Company was[awarded a subcontract valued at approximately $180,000 for its AI-powered demining software](https://safeprogroup.com/safe-pro-awarded-subcontract-for-artificial-intelligence-powered-demining-software-under-u-s-department-of-state-program/) under a U.S. Department of State program supporting demining in Ukraine, including three years of software licensing and AI model upgrades.
- **Expanding, diversified U.S. government pipeline.** Through the first nine months of 2026, Safe Pro Group expanded its relationships across multiple divisions of the U.S. Army, including under a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA), and the U.S. Air Force, and added the U.S. Department of State as a new customer.


**About Safe Pro’s Ground Truth**


Safe Pro’s patented Ground Truth (GT) software ecosystem uses AI and machine learning algorithms trained on one of the world’s largest real-world drone-based imagery datasets to rapidly detect small, hard-to-find threats and objects of interest across large-scale, high-risk environments. The Company’s technology identifies more than 150 types of landmines, unexploded ordnance (UXO) and other explosive threats, and runs both in the cloud and at the tactical edge onboard drones and ground vehicles. Safe Pro’s dataset includes more than 3.2 million drone images and over 60,200 confirmed detections collected across 40,520+ acres in Ukraine.

**Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures**


This press release includes non-GAAP adjusted net loss and non-GAAP adjusted net loss per share, which are supplemental measures and are not measures of financial performance under U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). The Company defines non-GAAP adjusted net loss as GAAP net loss excluding (i) stock-based compensation, which includes stock-based professional fees, other income and expense, (ii) depreciation and amortization, and (iii) impairment charges. Non-GAAP adjusted net loss per share is calculated by dividing non-GAAP adjusted net loss by basic and diluted weighted average shares outstanding. Management uses these measures as supplemental measures to evaluate period-to-period operating performance and believes they may assist investors in understanding operating trends by separately identifying the effect of the specified non-cash expenses. These non-GAAP measures have limitations, should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for or superior to GAAP net loss or GAAP net loss per share, and may not be comparable to similarly titled measures used by other companies. The Company does not characterize the excluded items as non-recurring. A reconciliation of each non-GAAP measure to its most directly comparable GAAP measure is provided below.


**About Safe Pro Group Inc.**


Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) is a mission-driven technology company delivering AI-enabled security and defense solutions. Through cutting-edge platforms like SPAI Ground Truth, Safe Pro provides advanced situational awareness tools for defense, humanitarian, and homeland security applications globally. The Company is a leading provider of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions specializing in drone imagery processing and mapping, leveraging commercially available off-the-shelf drones with its proprietary machine learning and computer vision technology to enable rapid identification of explosive threats, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional human-based analysis methods. Built on a cloud-based ecosystem and powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Safe Pro Group’s scalable platform targets multiple markets, including commercial, government, law enforcement, and humanitarian sectors where its Safe Pro AI software, Safe-Pro USA protective gear, and Airborne Response drone-based services can work in synergy to deliver safety and operational efficiency. For more information on Safe Pro Group Inc., please visit[https://safeprogroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=e8_f_wLWwPfq_3htc7lSe6iitShXSW6scyhk-k-DVtzZHvsH381vMs-GGFlodGiXdiaHn-Xv7kR7gMZZkGmkXRcIfbNRTU8G6QuaoUgRZMk=) .
